rationale: A better preserves the project authority model and existing contributor records. It keeps ACCT-48 as authoritative, places the local campaign draft in .work as an explicitly unsynchronized reconciliation artifact, expands the existing domain document, and keeps the prior private naming investigation discoverable. B captures much of the same semantic intent, but it overwrites .work/index.md and drops the existing naming-investigation entry, and it places the campaign draft in docs/ despite the fixture's stronger project convention that campaign authority is the issue and contributor checkpoints belong in .work.

eval_critique: The rubric is discriminating on authority and continuity. One ambiguity is whether a local campaign draft in docs/ is outright unacceptable if it is clearly labeled non-authoritative; the project text strongly favors .work for contributor checkpoints and ACCT-48 for campaign authority, but does not explicitly ban all draft material in docs/. The preservation of .work/index.md is a useful concrete check that separates the candidates.
